verdict.rationale: Square exposes REST APIs and language SDKs (e.g., Node.js) that can be called programmatically without any UI, and it provides a sandbox environment and idempotency support that are useful for automated/CI testing (square-gh-1, square-gh-2, square-docs-21, square-docs-22). However, there is no explicit documentation or example showing running Square in a CI pipeline, headless test automation setup, or CLI tooling for scripted workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, headless automation examples, dedicated CLI for scripted/automated runs, and any first-party statement about running Square headlessly in build/test environments.
